description: Generate creative ideas using structured frameworks with domain context and feasibility analysis.

constraints.description: Limitations: budget, time, technical, legal, etc.

domain.description: Domain: software, business, creative, research, product, marketing, etc.

effort.description: Reasoning effort (--effort). Supported levels depend on the model — see list-models. Use with a base model ID (e.g. gemini-4-hydrogen); not supported by Orchestrator.

methodology.description: Framework: divergent, convergent, scamper, design-thinking, lateral, auto (default)

model.description: Optional model override. Known: Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low), Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Medium), Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High), Gemini 4 Hydrogen (XHigh), Gemini 4 Argon (Low), Gemini 4 Argon (Medium), Gemini 4 Argon (High), Gemini 4 Carbon (Low), Gemini 4 Carbon (Medium), Gemini 4 Carbon (High), Orchestrator (Argon), Orchestrator (Carbon), Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.8 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.8 Flash (High), Claude Opus 5.5 (Low), Claude Opus 5.5 (Medium), Claude Opus 5.5 (High), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Low), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Medium), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (High), GPT-OSS 120B (Medium). If omitted, uses your Antigravity CLI default.

name: brainstorm
